name: Metamagic Rod, Chain
body:
Price Varies Lesser chain metamagic rod 14,000 gp Chain metamagic rod 54,000 gp Greater chain metamagic rod 121,500 gp; Aura strong (no school); CL 17; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are chained as though using the Chain Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost Varies Lesser chain metamagic rod 7,000 gp Chain metamagic rod 27,000 gp Greater chain metamagic rod 60,750 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Chain Spell
